name: tpl-precedence-1-goal~p3
task: First move the ball off the door, then take the key, open the door with it and pick up the box.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: The task orders four commanded steps (move the ball, take the key, open the door, pick up the box). The three hard Precedence clauses chain them in that order, and the hard Existence on target_picked_up is the last step and forces the earlier ones. No clause is added, redundant, or soft where the task is firm, and the compiler's finish-requirement list matches the task's four events.

texts: Eventually pick up the target box (the final step of the ordered sequence, so it is the only hard goal)
Open the door only after the key has been taken (take the key, then open the door with it)
Take the key only after the ball has been moved off the door (first move the ball off the door, then take the key)
Pick up the box only after the door has been opened (open the door, then pick up the box)
